simple.summary: טְאֵב (ṭᵉʼêb) means to rejoice First listed occurrence: Dan 6 24.

definitions.full: H2868. teeb טְאֵב verb be good ( ᵑ7 Syriac, see Biblical Hebrew טוֺב ); — Pe Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ט , with עַל person Dan 6:24 it was good to him = he was glad (compare בְּאֵשׁ 6:15 ).
